description: This file implements logging functionalities for the Rialto project, including log level management, log handlers for file and system logging, and utility functions for converting log levels and components to strings. It manages different logging components and levels, and provides mechanisms to output logs to various destinations such as files, syslog, or journald.

methods.name: componentToString
methods.description: Converts a RIALTO_COMPONENT enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: levelToString
methods.description: Converts a RIALTO_DEBUG_LEVEL enum value to its string abbreviation.

methods.name: fdLogHandler
methods.description: Handles logging output to a file descriptor, formatting timestamp, level, component, thread ID, and message.

methods.name: journaldLogHandler
methods.description: Handles logging output to journald or syslog, formatting message with level, component, and thread ID.

methods.name: rialtoLog
methods.description: Core logging function that formats the message and dispatches it to the appropriate handler based on configuration.
